LanguageData.LP_Aarakocra.label: aarakocra
LanguageData.LP_Aarakocra.description: A winged avian race with hollow bones. Aarakocra can spread their wings and soar more than 12 cells away; walls, fences and rivers cannot stop them. They have keen eyes, excel at archery and are happiest working under the open sky. The price is a frail body, poor melee and a sour mood when cooped up under a roof for too long. The bloodline is passed on to children.
LanguageData.LP_Aarakocra.descriptionShort: Inheritable. Can "Soar" over walls and water (12 cells), +10% move speed, good at shooting; body size 0.9, brittle bones, delicate, poor at melee, claustrophobic.
